reader_summary.headline: Mohnish Pabrai shares investing wisdom and his unique friendship with Guy Spier.
reader_summary.overview: Mohnish Pabrai discusses how to find resilient businesses with strong managers and low debt. He explains that great investors can hold large positions in rare companies if they understand the true risks. The episode also highlights Pabrai's deep personal connection with investor Guy Spier.

key_points.text: Great managers should keep big stakes in rare companies that compound well over time.
key_points.evidence_quote: In my opinion, that a great fund manager should after 20 or 30 years end up at 95% in one stock.

key_points.text: Some businesses are more resilient because they contain many smaller businesses inside one company.
key_points.evidence_quote: I think Constellation is a more resilient business than Walmart, because it is 1,000 businesses in one.

key_points.text: You can find safe bets with huge upside by buying companies that have lots of cash and no debt.
key_points.evidence_quote: Ipsco is Canadian company with $40 stock price. They have $15 a share in cash on their balance sheet, no debt.

key_points.text: Pabrai and Guy Spier share a deep connection because they truly understand each other.
key_points.evidence_quote: I told him that I concluded that it was because he sees me. You remember the avatar movie? I see you.

positions.commentary: The speaker references Warren Buffett's 4% rule as a law of physics regarding finding companies like Constellation.
The speaker notes that while Walmart is many businesses in one, it does not have 1,000 businesses like Constellation.
The speaker criticizes limiting a position in Constellation to under 10% as desecration of the temple.
The speaker praises the ethics of Mark Lander who pays personally for his business class travel.
The speaker mentions Mark Lander is German and did not take a base salary or bonus.
The speaker mentions the feeling of control when things are going well.
The speaker mentions that if you are not an investor, you probably want money fully invested in growth funds.
